chapter.heading: Psalm 123Prayer for the Lord’s Help.A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
Unto you
I lift up my eyes,O You who are enthroned in the heavens!

Behold, as
the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master,And as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,So our eyes look to the Lord our God,Until He is gracious and favorable toward us.

¶Be gracious
to us, O Lord, be gracious and favorable toward us,For we are greatly filled with contempt.

Our soul
is greatly filledWith the scoffing of those who are at ease,And with the contempt of the proud [who disregard God’s law].
